item.title: Legacy’s Clifton, Broomfield’s Brown and Penfold lose in semifinals
item.description: DENVER — Legacy’s Matthew Clifton put both hands on his side and walked back across the mat where his dreams had just been crushed. The state wrestling tournament at Ball Arena is home to some of the great success stories in the sport. But for most high schoolers that reach the championships, it ends with at least some disappointment. Clifton talked about winning a state title for two years. item.title: Broomfield’s Shayla Martinez remains perfect as she repeats as state wrestling champ
item.description: DENVER — Broomfield freshman Bella Barajas was conflicted at the state wrestling tournament Saturday evening. Standing inside the tunnels at Ball Arena, now in street clothes, she beamed when asked about her sister, Shayla Martinez, the early headlining champion who had just won her second straight 5A girls 190-pound title. item.title: Holy Family’s Breezy Johnston finishes Class 4A state wrestling runner-up
item.description: Coming into her Class 4A, 125-pound state wrestling championship match at Ball Arena on Saturday night, Holy Family's Breezy Johnston was the girl who couldn't be tamed in the classification. She had only lost one match all year.
